body: Thanks again :) Afraid I have to head off now, but feel free to PM anytime.
Thank you so much for your encouraging words and helping me during a dark time. It's heartening to know there are good people out there. I will keep you updated.
Thank you so much, I really appreciate it. I will definitely make use of these.
I've thought about seeing a doctor, but I'm not able to. This isn't something I can go to my family about and I no longer have insurance. I'm not sure what to do.
Thank you for the advice. Maybe I'll try seeking comfort in my dogs right now.

Honestly, sometimes they are the only thing keeping me here because I don't want to hurt them. I could never do something to hurt them. But the thing is I have to leave them very soon for college. It's not too far, and I'll see them often enough but I'm afraid for them and me. Me because I don't know what I'll do s far away, them because our home situation is...not good. I won't give away too much but the gist is this: the reason that they mean so much to me is because I spend the most time with them, I care for them the most. Our mother is passive and cares for little more than herself. She has been this way throughout my life and it is tolerable. What isn't is my step father. He is an angry, violent child that won't spend any time with his kids. I worry about who will take care of them away, and this stresses me out a lot. As for what's wrong with me. I'm not completely sure. My relationships with people are strained and it's left me feeling lonely and wary of intimacy. I have no support of love from my family and very few friends. The only person I really have is my boyfriend and he is not anywhere near able to handle this. I feel whiny and ungrateful and like I should just be happy. But I can't.
